answer: The rope tester hangs the finished rope from the beam and loads it stone by stone until it sings. Knot hemp rope layer net seal is the loading: a seal hemp rope layers renew after laying yard hearings. The terrace is the first stone hung, the lotus the last before the rope is judged, and the umber is the beam, black with tar and time. A cheat must hang 13 false stones and judge 13 false beams.
